actions.reason: C0001 shows strong, coherent RNA pathway enrichment (immune activation, metabolic suppression) with large effect sizes, supported by BAP1 mutation enrichment and CNV changes (chr7/12/20, CDKN2A loss). Confounder analysis shows no significant technical associations. Cross-modal consistency is weak overall but RNA provides the strongest signal, and the set is not a simple echo of stage/grade. The evidence supports a distinct immune-active ccRCC subtype.

C0002 shows the reciprocal RNA pathway pattern (immune suppression, metabolic activation) with large effect sizes, BAP1 mutation depletion, and mirror-image CNV changes. Confounder analysis shows no significant technical associations. Cross-modal consistency is weak but RNA provides the strongest signal, and the set is not a simple echo of stage/grade. The evidence supports a distinct, complementary subtype.
